The structure of CsNaMg crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Cs8Na8Mg8) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Cs center has eight geometric neighbors (4 Mg, 4 Na), while each Mg and Na center has eight Cs neighbors, all at 3.9094 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cs-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Mg- and Na-centered polyhedra.
